_conforms_to.spec: Anthropic MCP tool-schema spec. PM-counter context per 3GPP TS 28.552.
_conforms_to.spec_section: MCP tools object; 3GPP TS 28.552 5G performance measurements
_conforms_to.schema_role: Declares the tool surface for mcp-ran, the FastMCP server exposing cell, PM counter, and RAN parameter tools to the RAN Domain Agent.

server_role: RAN-side diagnostic tools for the RAN Domain Agent

tools.name: get_cell_sync_state
tools.description: Returns the cell-level sync state, RU timing reference quality, and holdover status. Maps roughly to gNB Time Resource Group state per 3GPP TS 38.300.

tools.name: list_pm_counters
tools.description: Returns recent PM counter samples for the named cell. Counter family per 3GPP TS 28.552 (PRACH detection rate, BLER, MAC scheduling, fronthaul telemetry).

tools.name: get_ran_param
tools.description: Returns the current value of a named RAN parameter (e.g. transmit power, neighbor list, carrier configuration). Read-only; modification happens via TMF921 intent through the partner SMO.
